notes: Bootstrap G0 passed after rebuilding stale aster-plugin artifacts and using the installed Corepack pnpm entry point.
A source-changing verification run was correctly rejected; the final full run passed with stable sources.
Foreground and background preview/render-queue smoke passed with preserved FFmpeg binaries.
The owner approved the local AMD host and requested continued work despite the original stop-on-blocker rules.
Generated 337 cases and 1819 frame addresses; coverage rejects unsampled, inactive and falsely labeled features.
Real media includes decoded frame-identity proof and independent image-sequence identity/hold-boundary cases. Owner data remains external.
The first full run exposed an existing 25 ms script sandbox initialization-timeout race. The final full run passed without altering the sandbox or its timeout.
Vite artifact watching was disabled and identical project writes avoided after a transient Windows replacement lock. No partial JSON was published.
No pixel comparison is claimed by corpus structural validation; reference capture and self-review remain pending.
history.next_step: M0-T3: capture production TS reference frames with source, case, media and adapter provenance.
M0-T4: implement CLI comparison metrics, structural checks, tolerance profiles and a deliberately rejected candidate.
notes: Captured every one of 337 cases: 1819 requested frame addresses plus 128 adjacent sequence frames, totaling 1947 lossless RGBA references.
A complete follow-up capture reused all 337 cases only after verifying PNG and metadata hashes, source/resource hashes, actual adapter and 282 system font identities.
An intentional one-second startup timeout failed, exited promptly and left the existing reference untouched. Late errors, stalled I/O and expired callbacks have dedicated regression coverage.

Strict capture diagnosed the existing Enchanted Love four-surface cap. Its valid fifth surface fit the unchanged target/pixel/estimated-byte budgets; admission and retained-cache accounting were repaired and all 140 sampled frames passed.

The original minimal-golden animation is fully occluded. Its reference is preserved and the misleading visible-animation feature label was removed; generated scenes and barcode media supply independent motion evidence.
No candidate pixel comparison or section 6.6 acceptance is claimed by this reference-capture increment.

history.next_step: M0-T5: record reproducible TS performance baselines on the owner-authorized AMD host, including full opening and main segments.
notes: Added a CPU-only Rust comparison library and thin CLI with bounded PNG decoding, RGB PSNR/SSIM, full RGBA error and alpha checks, error components, ink bounds, phase correlation and strict sequence identity.

All 53 library tests and two CLI integration tests pass; independent numeric counterexamples prevent unchanged alpha from diluting color quality scores. Phase correlation rejects ambiguous, periodic, low-signal and incoherent inputs.

Exact identical reference pixels passed diagnostic G3. Removing a 20 by 20 interior patch failed G3 with a 400-pixel error component, 0.6944% alpha changes and RGB PSNR 30.141 dB. Direct contact-sheet and heatmap inspection confirmed the defect; the deliberate probe has a rejected structural self-review.

G3 verifies every reference and sequence neighbor against the ledger-approved renderer source, recomputes capture identity, checks full corpus coverage, and binds review reuse to all metrics and three hashed evidence files.

RustFFT and its pure-Rust dependency additions passed cargo deny and cargo audit. Existing JavaScript audit findings were repaired from 54 to zero without ignored advisories; the builder downloader compatibility adapter passed local HTTP, timeout, checksum, retry and proxy tests.

Electron 43.5.0 passed full foreground/background G6. Original Electron 43.4.1 reference pixels remain pinned and untouched; whole-corpus upgrade pixel equivalence is still required before any reference replacement.
M0 performance baselines and milestone exit remain pending; the oracle diagnostic does not claim native rendering or full corpus candidate parity.

history.next_step: M0-T6: exact whole-corpus current-Electron candidate comparison against the preserved TS reference, then validate complete milestone exit evidence.
notes: Added a release-bundled performance harness using the existing production render-host loop, original frame formats, video synchronization, bounded readback concurrency and audiovisual MP4 writer.

Nine measured workload/mode groups contain three full runs each after the complete warm-up suite. The 14,526 measured frames preserve owner opening [0,714), main [714,1014), and 600-frame synthetic composite/effect workloads.

All real IPC frame/audio byte counts and MP4 FFprobe frame/stream/duration checks passed. Source, resources, actual FFmpeg binaries and the owner-authorized Radeon 780M hardware identity remained stable.

On this separate local series, main-segment medians are 44.57 FPS readback, 31.90 FPS ordinary IPC and 28.42 FPS full MP4. Opening full MP4 is 14.88 FPS. The existing manager selected libx264; these figures do not satisfy the later native encoder gates or compare against historical NVIDIA numbers.
Committed raw samples and provenance are SHA-bound and independently audited in G0; missing samples, changed summaries, wrong adapter, malformed exports and path escapes are rejected.

Full G0/G6 passed, including rebuilt foreground preview and background render queue smoke. M0 exit and the Electron patch pixel-equivalence check remain pending.
